subject.title: Discord plugin does not auto-reconnect after 1006 WS close (forces full gateway restart, kills in-flight turns)

question: Is the July 6 and July 8 release evidence enough to sponsor a Discord reconnect repair now, or should maintainers require a current-main live/transport-harness reproduction first?
rationale: The issue is credible and high-impact, but the current code already contains a reconnect scheduler, so the remaining blocker is proof of the exact failed runtime path rather than a straightforward missing branch.

options.title: Require current-main reconnect proof
options.body: Capture a focused live or transport-harness 1005/1006 close that shows whether current main still wedges before authorizing a repair.

options.title: Sponsor exploratory repair now
options.body: Allow an owner to instrument and harden the Discord gateway lifecycle based on the release repros, accepting that the first PR may mainly add diagnostics and harness coverage.

options.title: Scope to operator fallback
options.body: Treat automatic recovery as unresolved and first expose or document a turn-safe channel-scoped restart path for Discord operators.

recommendation.title: Require current-main reconnect proof
recommendation.body: Capture a focused live or transport-harness 1005/1006 close that shows whether current main still wedges before authorizing a repair.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the densest recent history in Discord gateway supervision and lifecycle hardening, so he is the best available owner for the proof threshold decision.
